ciAtTestedHead: Read on GitHub at d0c01b1b: lint, typecheck, pr-title, Docs build and Worker Image build succeeded. The required `test` failed only in TestApplyFact*/TestPromotion* with `read a slotted issue … got 20 and 31`, which is main's failure before #2317. GitHub made this run's merge ref at 04:16:15Z, #2317 (baadccdc) merged at 04:19:29Z, and main's Tests run has been green since then (40449104347, 40451059126). A rerun keeps the old merge commit. A push without the skip-checks trailer, which retro's push is, makes a new merge ref with #2317. Envoy and Contracts attempt 2 (40448807666) is queued, and its attempt 1 was cancelled. This PR changes no Go code.
notes: Post-merge items stay with the production check: AC1 over every later pull-request run, AC2 (the one-off delete and the report), AC3 (notices p90 < 3 min for 72 h) and the 'main still writes' guard. The save branch (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') cannot run before the merge. pull_request runs use the merge commit's workflow files, so every pull-request run after the merge follows the new rule.

Outside this change: the seven envoy-and-contracts setup-go sites on default caching (dispatch, envoy-go, envoy-go-race, dispatch-memory, dispatch-multiprocess, broker-multiprocess, envoy-smoke) never restore or save a Go cache, because setup-go finds no go.mod or go.sum at the repository root and no cache-dependency-path is set. They write nothing, so AC1 holds. Reported to the architect, because it is CI waste for the INFRA-490 tree.
